Sydney is located on Australia's southeastern coast in New South Wales. It is a vibrant metropolis built around one of the world's most spectacular harbours, famously lined by the iconic Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge. But beyond its world-famous landmarks, the city also boasts a stunning coastline, diverse neighbourhoods, and a thriving culinary scene.
